options.name: aiDriven
options.description: AiDriven query parameter. The issue's AI driven value YES or NO (case insensitive) (Use only when macAddress and deviceId are not provided).

options.name: deviceId
options.description: DeviceId query parameter. Assurance UUID value of the device in the issue content.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. Ending epoch time in milliseconds of query time window.

options.name: issueStatus
options.description: IssueStatus query parameter. The issue's status value ACTIVE, IGNORED, RESOLVED (case insensitive).

options.name: macAddress
options.description: MacAddress query parameter. Client's device MAC address of the issue (format xx xx xx xx xx xx).

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority query parameter. The issue's priority value P1, P2, P3, or P4 (case insensitive) (Use only when macAddress and deviceId are not provided).

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. Assurance UUID value of the site in the issue content.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. Starting epoch time in milliseconds of query time window.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
